name: akios
description: Agentic workflow kit for Swift/iOS repos: spec-driven idea-to-ship pipeline, skill gates, and repo onboarding.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven Swift/iOS workflow kit for Codex
interface.longDescription: Use Akios to brainstorm, plan, design, deliver, review, and maintain Swift/iOS features through an agent-readable workflow. Codex support currently exposes the shared skill family; Claude Code remains the full command and setup host.
defaultPrompt: Use Akios to plan this iOS feature.
Review this Swift task with Akios.
Turn this iOS idea into a spec.
